weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.empty: No weddings yet. The first one you create shows up here.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.help: We’ll send you a six-digit code. There is no password.

invite.title: Create your account

enroll.title: Sign in faster on this device?
enroll.body: With a passkey you sign in with your face, your fingerprint, or your password manager. No more email.

errors.emailFormat: That doesn’t look like a valid email address.

errors.codeWrongOne: That code isn’t right. One attempt left.

errors.codeExpired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.deliveryFailed: That address doesn’t accept mail. Try another one.
errors.unavailable: Signing in isn’t working right now. Try again shortly.
errors.offline: No connection. Your code is still here.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
